	definition:
		productCatalogs: Set(ProductCatalog) = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->select(pc|pc.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->isUnique(o: ProductCatalog|o.Id)
	postcondition:

		newPc.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newPc) and
